entities.name: Lyana
entities.description: A girl of about 11 or 12 from a Realm of Kaldheim with aqua eyes and magical abilities; protected by the wolf Kit.

entities.name: Lathril
entities.description: Elf bestowed with divine powers who protected Lyana and retrieved Kit.

entities.name: Sarulf
entities.description: The Cosmos Wolf, father of Kit and Lukya, who gave Kit to Lyana as protection and blessed Lathril.

entities.name: Kit
entities.description: Lyana's wolf companion, a child of Sarulf, kidnapped by a draugr.

entities.name: Lukya
entities.description: Lathril's wolf companion and sister of Kit.

entities.name: Draugr
entities.description: Hostile creatures that attacked Lyana and Kit.

events.summary: Draugr attack Lyana and Kit during a walk in the woods, and one seizes and kidnaps Kit.
events.quote: one of the draugr seized Kit and kidnapped him

events.summary: Lathril and Lukya come to Lyana's aid; Lathril retrieves Kit.
Sarulf blesses Lathril, creating a permanent bond between the elves and wolves of Kaldheim.
events.quote: creating a permanent bond between the elves and wolves of Kaldheim

relations.quote: became a protector and guide for Lyana
